questions.question: A soil layer has a saturated unit weight of \( \gamma_{sat} = 18.8\ \text{kN/m}^3 \). Calculate the critical hydraulic gradient \( i_c \). Take the unit weight of water as \( \gamma_w = 9.81\ \text{kN/m}^3 \).

A soil has particle sizes \(D_{10} = 0.20\ \text{mm}\), \(D_{30} = 0.45\ \text{mm}\), and \(D_{60} = 0.80\ \text{mm}\). Determine the coefficient of uniformity \(C_u\) and the coefficient of curvature \(C_c\).

If a soil sample has a void ratio of \( e = 1.3 \), determine its porosity \( n \).
references:
FE Reference Handbook 10.5 P259:

Use the relationship between porosity and void ratio:

    \[

\begin{align}

n &= \frac{e}{1 + e} \\

&= \frac{1.3}{1 + 1.3} \\

&= 0.57

\end{align}

\]

questions.question: In open-channel hydraulics, what are conjugate (sequent) depths?
questions.answer: Two flow depths in the same open channel that have the same momentum function for the same discharge, often occurring as sequent depths across a hydraulic jump.
